results.actual_localization_gate: For that nonconstant-leading pencil, k[z,w] intersect L equals k: the highest T-coefficient of a polynomial involving w has positive z-degree. The actual polynomial representative a0(y,z,w)=EX belongs to this intersection, so a lies in C[y].
